title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Position Overview:**

The Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth by acquiring hospitals and healthcare institutions for Insurance Claim Management Software. The role involves strategic sales planning, managing key accounts, building partnerships, and leading the regional sales efforts.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Identify and acquire medium and large hospitals across Vijayawada and surrounding regions

· Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly targets

· Build strong relationships with hospital management, administrators, and decision-makers

· Conduct product presentations and demos for hospital stakeholders

· Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to closure

· Drive partnerships with hospital associations, TPAs, and healthcare networks

· Track sales performance and maintain pipeline in CRM

· Coordinate with onboarding and product teams for smooth implementation

· Mentor and guide sales executives (if applicable)

· Represent the company in healthcare events, conferences, and networking forums

**Qualification:**

· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or related field

· MBA (preferred but not mandatory)

**Experience:**

· 1+ years of experience in Field Sales

· Prior experience in hospital, insurance, or healthcare ecosystem is a strong advantage

· Proven track record of achieving sales targets

**Skills:**

· Strong sales and negotiation skills

· Excellent communication and presentation abilities

· Relationship-building and stakeholder management

· Understanding of healthcare or insurance processes (preferred)

· Self-driven, target-oriented mindset

· Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Regional Sales Manager-TAP-G& V
description:
Job Overview:

We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Regional Sales Manager to lead

and manage our sales operations in Guntur & Vijayawada This role will be responsible for developing and implementing

sales strategies, managing a team of sales professionals, and achieving revenue growth

within the designated region. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership,

communication, and strategic skills to drive business performance.

A Regional Sales Manager is a leadership role within a company's sales department,

responsible for overseeing sales operations within a specific geographic region. This

person manages a team of sales representatives, sets sales goals, develops strategies to

drive revenue, and ensures that targets are met. Their role typically includes:

1. Team Leadership: Recruiting, training, and managing a team of sales professionals.

2. Sales Strategy: Developing and executing sales strategies for their region to meet or exceed

targets.

3. Performance Tracking: Monitoring sales metrics and KPIs, analyzing performance, and

adjusting strategies as needed.

4. Customer Relationship Management: Building and maintaining relationships with key

clients or prospects in the region.

5. Budgeting and Forecasting: Managing the region's sales budget and providing accurate sales

forecasts.

6. Market Analysis: Conducting research to understand market trends, competition, and

customer needs in the region.

Key Responsibilities:

 Sales Strategy Development: Create and implement sales strategies tailored to the regional

market to achieve sales targets and grow market share.

 Team Management: Lead, coach, and motivate a team of sales representatives, ensuring they

are meeting individual and team sales goals.

 Revenue Growth: Maximize sales opportunities and drive revenue growth across the region

by identifying new markets, prospects, and customer segments.

 Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key

customers, partners, and stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty.

 Sales Forecasting & Reporting: Provide accurate sales forecasts and performance reports to

senior management on a regular basis. Track and analyze sales data to identify opportunities

for improvement.

 Budget Management: Oversee regional sales budgets, ensuring resources are allocated

efficiently to drive sales performance.

 Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing, product, and customer service teams to

ensure alignment in strategies and effective execution.

 Training & Development: Ensure ongoing training and professional development for sales

teams to enhance performance and product knowledge.

Qualifications:

 Qualification - Any degree

 Min 8+ years of proven experience in sales, with at least 5years in a leadership role managing

sales teams.

 Strong understanding of regional market dynamics, customer behaviors, and competitive

landscape.

 Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

 Ability to develop and implement strategic plans to achieve business goals.

 Results-oriented with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

 Ability to travel within the region as required.

Skills & Competencies:

 Leadership & Team Management

 Sales Strategy & Planning

 Negotiation & Closing Skills

 Market Analysis & Research

 Budgeting & Forecasting

 Communication & Presentation Skills

 Problem-solving & Decision-making

Work Environment:

 Full-time position with a dynamic and fast-paced work environment.

 Travel with in the region

 Competitive salary, Incentives and other benefits

Email:coshr1@muthootgroup.com

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Associate Intern
description:
Role Overview:

Neptor is looking for a proactive Business Development Executive Intern with strong communication skills, local market knowledge, and a basic understanding of website development. The candidate will identify potential clients, pitch Neptor's solutions, and generate new business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

**Identify potential clients and new business opportunities across relevant industries.**  Connect with local business owners and decision-makers.  
**Pitch Neptor's products and services and follow up on leads.**  Research market opportunities and identify suitable sectors for business expansion.  
**Understand basic website development concepts and communicate client requirements to technical teams.**  Collaborate with marketing, technical, and other internal teams.

**Required Skills:**  
**Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.**   
Good understanding of the Vijayawada local business market.

**Basic knowledge of website development and digital solutions.**  Ability to identify opportunities and approach clients independently.  
**Willingness to learn, take initiative, and work collaboratively.**   
**Preferred: Candidates familiar with the local business ecosystem.**   
**Prior sales or business development experience is an advantage but not mandatory.**

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mumbai, Maharashtra
